purpose: Track exact current pre-midi and pre-programmed music compatibility, serialized instruction size and game runtime cost separately. Audit only; does not authorize a game player rewrite.

instruction_format.cause: The game uses an unported legacy v2 parser/scheduler with waveform-per-instrument fields; studio Beats require Sound/Rack patches, Chunk placements and samples, and Songs add Tracks, Clips and Recordings.
instruction_format.file_format: Plain UTF-8 JSON instructions; sample/recording metadata names a separate relative Asset. Portable asset-bearing projects use companion ZIP files.

capability_matrix.bridge: legacy reader remains for existing game saves; no silent rewrite
version dispatch/validator plus native Beat event scheduler
v2 patch modulation sources, routing and native/web synth voice
sample-timed cutoff automation with seek and loop parity
referenced Beats, Beat Clips/Tracks, overlap and repetitions
modulation, automation and WAV vocal metadata variants

capability_matrix.studio: two oscillators, harmonic recipes, filter, effects
capability_matrix.bridge: small playback-only synth core, not studio authoring controls

capability_matrix.studio: external Asset zones, recorded samples and hit racks
capability_matrix.bridge: game Media Asset resolver and bounded sample voice renderer

capability_matrix.studio: placements with offsets/repeats and overlapping events
Beat and vocal Clips, layered Songs
capability_matrix.bridge: song clock and clip reference dispatch

capability_matrix.studio: static authored music instructions and instrument parameters
capability_matrix.game: general game state/effect system; no modern music layer contract
capability_matrix.bridge: game-owned play/stop/seek/layer/parameter commands without embedding scripting into .premidi
preserve independent SFX feature; do not count it as .premidi parity

size_accounting.instruction_bytes: generated from actual studio models and example export-shaped JSON
size_accounting.gzip_bytes: informational only; not the current .premidi storage format
size_accounting.external_audio_asset_bytes: not measured by instruction harness; report separately from ZIP payload
size_accounting.warning: Source-code line counts, compressed JSON size and the pre-midi portable ZIP do not establish added pre-programmed runtime size. Measure a real game build before claiming a budget.

game_dependent_optional: audio asset codec decoders needed by selected external Assets
advanced modulation or effects used by a particular score
native audio device host if game runtime selects C++ engine
studio_only: piano roll and synth editor UI
microphone recording and input permission handling
full import support for every source file codec and extreme rate
runtime_boundary.enforcement: Resolve runtime features from validated score semantics, not from presence of studio UI; reject unsupported features with explicit version/capability errors rather than silently changing sound.
runtime_boundary.asset_contract: Reference external audio by safe relative path/ID; avoid embedded bytes, duplicate references, or implicit browser caches. Test project export/import independently.
runtime_boundary.legacy_data: Keep v2 documents and existing .ppgame files accessible via explicit legacy dispatch/migration.

platform_choice.game_web_and_desktop: pre-programmed currently ships browser/Electron Web Audio UI with a separate v2 music renderer; its desktop host is Electron
platform_choice.studio_web_and_desktop: pre-midi ships browser Web Audio plus a Tauri C++ native Windows host
platform_choice.initial_parity_candidate: share a portable score/plan contract and browser-compatible playback implementation; leave the C++ host optional until compiled size, CPU and device latency benefits are independently measured
platform_choice.do_not_assume: A 14.4 MB pre-midi portable ZIP is neither the game runtime cost nor an argument for loading Tauri or native import decoders into the Electron game.
